content: Yes, that's correct. In Switzerland, the adult health insurance franchise (or deductible) is typically set at CHF 150 per year for adult policyholders. After you've met this deductible amount, you are responsible for co-payments for medical treatments and services, and there is no upper limit on these co-payments. This means you can incur co-payments for any number of treatments or services until the end of the insurance year, without any cap. However, the amount of co-payments can vary depending on the specific medical service, prescribed medications, or interventions.
